page.layout: One column of running text, full width. No margin notes. Running head at top, page number at top right, catchword and gathering signature at foot.

main_text.p: stas ministrant. In omnibus igitur iis iudiciis, in quib. EX « FIDE BONA est additum, plurimus eorū usus est. (Sic enim legendum arbitror, non EARVM.) ubi vero etiam « VT INTER BONOS BE-« NE AGIER OPORTET, « in primisque in arbitrio rei « vxoriæ, in quo est QVID « AEQVIVS MELIVS, parati esse debent. Illi enim dolū « malum, illi fidem bonam, illi « æquum bonum, illi quid so-« cium socio: quid eum qui ne-« gotia aliena curasset, ei cuius « ea negotia fuissent, quid eū « qui mandasset, eū ue cui mā-« datum esset, alterū alteri prę[?] «

page.notes: Printed "«" marks stand at line ends throughout and are transcribed as printed. "ftas" read as "stas" (long s). "ijs" read as "iis" and "iudicijs" as "iudiciis" per i/j rule. Line "cium fo-cio" in the scan reads "cium socio" in my transcription; the word at "fo-" is doubtful and should be checked. "pr§" at the end is read as "prę" and marked [?]. "eü" is read as "eū" with macron-like mark. "mā datum" is written joined as printed hyphenless break. Catchword "ftare" read as "stare". The page number "55" is printed at the top right.
